name: Slack Enterprise Custom App
description: Slack Enterprise Custom App describes an internally managed Slack app installed for an Enterprise organization and granted to selected member workspaces.
agentUseSummary: This enterprise setup is visible as a canonical-provider extension preview. Relay will keep Slack tools and policy on the canonical connector, but will not collect customer app secrets or treat an organization token as an ordinary workspace installation.

capabilities.label: Use an enterprise-managed Slack installation
capabilities.description: After the canonical Slack connector supports organization installs, bind one approved enterprise installation to its explicitly granted workspaces and typed Slack actions.

blocked.label: Create duplicate Slack connection state
blocked.description: An enterprise custom-app listing must not create a second Slack tool registry, approval policy or token lifecycle beside the canonical connector.

blocked.label: Capture customer Slack app secrets
blocked.description: Relay will not ask an enterprise user to paste a client secret, signing secret, app token or bot token into this Marketplace alias.

blocked.label: Create, approve or distribute a Slack app
blocked.description: App creation, scopes, org readiness, approval policy and workspace grants are Slack developer and enterprise-admin operations outside Relay agent actions.

blocked.label: Use an org token without a workspace binding
blocked.description: Organization tokens can span multiple workspaces and some Slack methods require team_id; Relay must bind every operation to an authorized enterprise and workspace.

blocked.label: Run Slack tools through this alias
blocked.description: All supported Slack actions remain on the canonical connector after enterprise installation semantics are implemented and verified there.

approvalProfiles.label: Canonical Slack extension required
approvalProfiles.description: This setup alias is not connectable. Organization-token storage, enterprise/workspace binding and all Slack runtime behavior must extend the canonical slack provider.

runtimeSupport.description: This alias installs no OpenClaw tools; enterprise support must reuse the canonical Slack runtime pack.
This alias installs no Hermes tools; enterprise support must reuse the canonical Slack runtime pack.

providerSetup.blocker: Slack organization-ready apps use an organization installation and token plus explicit workspace grants; API calls and events require enterprise-aware identity and sometimes team_id. Relay's canonical Slack connector is currently workspace-bound and does not accept customer-owned app secrets.
providerSetup.nextAction: Extend the canonical slack connector with enterprise_id, is_enterprise_install, granted-workspace and team_id binding; validate org OAuth storage and routing; preserve the existing four typed actions and policies. App creation, approval and distribution remain enterprise-admin setup outside Relay.

evidence.supports: Slack documents one organization authorization and token, explicit grants to selected workspaces, org-admin distribution and OAuth, UI or CLI installation paths.
Slack documents Enterprise organizations as multiple workspaces with distinct IDs, channels, files and app-installation concerns.
Slack documents enterprise installation identifiers, is_enterprise_install event context, team_id routing requirements and multi-workspace token behavior.
Slack documents Org Owner and Org Admin policies for app approval, restriction and installation across enterprise workspaces.
